entries.title: Revelation of John 4:1
segments: After these things I looked, and behold, a door [was] opened in Heaven. And the first voice which I heard [was] as it were of a trumpet talking with me, saying, Come up here, and I will show you what must occur after these things.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:2
segments: And immediately I became in spirit. And behold, a throne was set in Heaven, and [One] sat upon the throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:3
segments: And He who sat there looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. And a rainbow [was] around the throne, looking like an emerald.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:4
segments: And around the throne [I saw] twenty-four thrones. And on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white clothing. And they had crowns of gold on their heads.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:5
segments: And out of the throne came lightnings and thunderings and voices. And seven lamps of fire [were] burning in front of the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:6
segments: And a sea of glass [was] in front of the throne, like crystal. And in [the] midst of the throne, and around the throne, [were] four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:7
segments: And the first living creature [was] like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had the face of a man, and the fourth living creature like a flying eagle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:8
segments: And each one of the four living creatures had six wings about [him], and within being full of eyes. And they had no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, the Almighty, who was and is and [is] to come.

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:9
segments: And whenever the living creatures gave glory and honor and thanks to Him who sat on the throne, who lives forever and ever,

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:10
segments: the twenty-four elders fell down before the One sitting on the throne. And they worshiped Him who lives for ever and ever, and threw their crowns before the throne, saying,

entries.title: Revelation of John 4:11
segments: O Lord, You are worthy to receive glory and honor and power, because You created all things, and for Your will they are and were created.
